text:
alex: hitting weird behavior in the Go gen sample: when we cancel a streaming generator the app exits but goroutine count keeps growing over repeated runs. seems tied to auth retries.
talia: which SDK version and which sample?
alex: go-sdk v0.12.1, `examples/generator/stream-example`. run `./stream-example --count 100 --timeout 1s` in a loop and watch `go tool pprof`/`goroutine` count.
alex: minimal pattern in the sample: create a stream, read first token, then cancel ctx. code: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
client := redwood.NewClient(apiKey)
iter, _ := client.Generator.Stream(ctx, req)
if iter.Next() { fmt.Println(iter.Token()) }
// cancel quickly
cancel()
// sometimes not calling iter.Close(), sometimes calling it
```
ron: does iter.Next() return false after cancel? or hang?
alex: frequently Next() returns false and Err() == context.Canceled, but the process shows multiple goroutines in net/http and in auth/refresher loops. stack traces show the refresher's retry loop blocking on a channel send and spawn new retries each time.
talia: that smells like the auth refresher uses a global work queue and doesn't attach request ctx; when the request is canceled it doesn't drain the per-request entry so the refresher keeps retrying.
ron: can you paste the trimmed goroutine dump?
alex: paste (edited):
```
goroutine 10234 [semacquire]:
internal/poll.runtime_pollWait(...)
net/http.(*persistConn).roundTrip(...)
github.com/redwood/sdk/auth.(*Refresher).retryWorker(0xc0000...)
created by github.com/redwood/sdk/auth.(*Refresher).Start
```
talia: thanks. I can repro locally with a tight timeout too. filing internal ticket: DEVEX-8421.
ron: potential quick fixes: 1) make refresher retry select on ctx.Done(), 2) ensure Stream iterator Close() cancels any per-request auth contexts, 3) have refresher drop work for canceled request IDs.
alex: workaround I used: wrap transport with a ctx-aware dial that returns on ctx.Done(), which reduces leak but isn't great.
talia: I'll sketch a small change: pass a per-request ctx into auth refresh calls (already plumbed in other SDKs). I'll open a draft PR and add a test that repeatedly starts/cancels streams and asserts goroutine count stabilizes.
ciara-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/912 — tests added (ci queued).
ron: also update the generator quickstart: explicitly show `defer iter.Close()` and note that auth retries are tied to request lifetime in v0.13.0.
alex: logging note: add a debug line when refresher receives canceled id so operators can see "auth: drop canceled req id=...". saved me hours figuring this out.
talia: agreed. I'll ping runtime and doc owners to coordinate release notes. thanks for the report. :shipit:
